resolved_validation_findings.finding: The supplied baseline has a present unsigned and stale AVB footer, not an absent footer.
resolved_validation_findings.resolution: Match the exact supplied image and footer presence without trusting that old signature metadata; require full signature and exact-image verification for the finished derivative.

resolved_validation_findings.finding: Pinned Kati refuses a real recovery image dependency on PHONY FORCE.
resolved_validation_findings.resolution: Keep ordinary real-file prerequisites and put unconditional verified copying on the phony recoveryimage entrypoint; preserve every Kati error check.

resolved_validation_findings.finding: The original generated recovery chain key selected the generic engineering test key, which differs from working76.
resolved_validation_findings.resolution: Schema 2 stages the exact verified public PEM and selects it for recovery chain metadata; no private signing key is transferred. A complete vbmeta chain is still not verified.
